If you do not have
 enough money, you 
may sell 1 or 2 
unnecessary animals.
hint_level_5_2:
You can bring goods,
 that you can not 
produce, from the
 city by plane.
hint_level_5_3:
Click here to buy the
 flour in the city.
new_game_are_you_sure: Are you sure you want to start new game? Your saved game will be lost.
leave_game: Do you want to leave a game?
start_game: Do you want to start a game?
continue_game: Do you want to continue your game?
promo_text: Thank you for playing Farm Frenzy 2 Lite!  Please tap the button to visit the App Store and purchase the entire game!  The full version does not contain messages like this one.  Plus, when you buy Farm Frenzy 2, it will help us create an even more captivating sequel!
subscribe_text: Be the first to find out about &quot;Farm Frenzy 3&quot;!You'll also get the scoop on upcoming games, discounts and any other news. Sign up today.  You can cancel any time!
hint_goose:
This is a chicken. 
It eats grass 
and produces eggs.
hint_grass_grow:
You need to grow
 the grass so the animal 
won't die of hunger.
hint_goose_buy:
Press the button
 to purchase one 
more chicken.
hint_egg:
This is an egg. 
Click it to dispatch
 it to the storehouse.
hint_goals:
These are your 
goals for the level.
hint_level_map:
This is a 
level marker. Tap it 
to start a game.
hint_car:
This is a car. 
It drives the goods you 
produce to town to sell.
hint_well:
This is a well. 
If your water supply 
is depleted, tap it
 to buy more water.
hint_bear:
This is a bear. 
It throws your 
animals offscreen
 and spoils goods. 
Capture it and put
 it in the cage
 to sell it.
hint_bear_click:
Tap the bear several 
times to catch it and
 put it into the cage.
hint_depot:
This is a storehouse. 
Animals and goods that 
can be sold are kept here.
hint_depot_button_1:
Tap this button
 to sell one 
of these goods.
hint_depot_button_all:
Tap this button
 to sell all of the 
goods of this kind.
hint_level_map_shop:
To open a new level, 
stop by the shop 
and buy the plans 
for the stated building.
hint_level_map_shop_inside:
Here you can upgrade 
your buildings using the 
stars you collected.
hint_level_map_blue_bottom:
This is where you 
can see what you need 
to buy in the shop 
to open a new level.
hint_buy_building:
Tap here to put 
up a building.
hint_dried_egg_house:
This is a plant 
for processing eggs. 
Tap it to turn 
your eggs into powder.
hint_building_produce:
Tap the building 
to dispatch the 
goods for processing.
hint_depot_full:
Your storehouse is full! 
Sell some of the goods 
to make more room.
hint_button_upgrade:
This is an 
upgrade button. 
Use it to buy 
better equipment.
hint_cake_house:
This is a bakery. 
Here tasty cakes are 
made from 
powdered eggs.
hint_spinnery:
This is a spinnery. 
Here threads can be 
made from wool.
hint_cow:
This is a cow. 
It eats grass 
and gives milk.
hint_cat:
This is a cat. 
It helps to 
collect goods.
hint_butter_house:
This is a churn. 
It makes butter 
from milk.
hint_sheep:
This is a pig. 
It eats grass and 
produces pork.
hint_dog:
This is a dog. 
It stops bears.
hint_cheese_house:
This is a cheese dairy. 
Here butter is made 
into cheese.
hint_textile_house:
This is a weaving mill. 
Here threads are made 
into cloth.
hint_no_money:
You don't have enough 
money to make 
the purchase.
hint_bear_cage:
A bear is now 
in the cage. 
Tap it to dispatch it 
to the storehouse. You 
can also sell the bear!
hint_product:
Animals eat grass 
and produce products
hint_airplane:
Tap on the plane 
and book necessary goods
